newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse suspends trading for the day.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse suspends trading for the day.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Monday it had suspended trading for the rest of the session due to flooding which has wreaked havoc in the capital.

"We have received official word that there is no (cheque) clearing due to the inclement weather so we are finally suspending trading," said Harry Liu, Philippine Stock Exchange governor, told local television.
